summary: Assess harmonic distortion, screen resonance and compare filter options. Explore this practical five-day course and strengthen your engineering assessments.
lede: Power system harmonics analysis covers identifying distortion sources, measuring harmonic spectra, and assessing impacts in electrical networks. For power quality and electrical engineers and operations professionals, the course develops a practical workflow for diagnosing nonlinear-load effects and recommending proportionate corrective action. You practise calculating THD and TDD, screening capacitor-bank resonance, comparing passive and active filter options, and documenting measurement-based findings for technical review.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who investigate waveform distortion, assess nonlinear loads, or review power quality decisions across electrical networks and facilities.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of electrical power systems, three-phase circuits, and basic power quality measurements. No coding or programming is required.
